description: Celosome Aqua is a non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid skinbooster formulated for intradermal biorevitalisation rather than volumising. It delivers a high load of purified, non-animal HA to restore dermal water content, improve elasticity and refresh dull, dehydrated skin. Supplied as a colourless, ready-to-use injectable gel for professional micro-injection.
howItWorks: As a hyaluronic acid booster, it works by binding water within the dermis to raise tissue hydration and turgor, while the free HA network supports fibroblast activity and the extracellular matrix. Mannitol acts as an antioxidant/stabiliser that helps protect the HA from free-radical degradation. The effect is hydration and skin-quality improvement rather than structural volume.
composition: Non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL (approx. 60 mg HA per syringe), 0.9% mannitol; non-animal (biofermentation) origin.
usageNotes: Delivered by intradermal micro-injection into the superficial to mid dermis (nappage/point technique) or via micro-injector. Typically a short course of sessions spaced a few weeks apart. Store at 2-25C, protect from direct sunlight and freezing; shelf life around 24 months. Prefilled and ready to use, no reconstitution required.
features: High HA concentration (24 mg/mL) for hydration
Mannitol antioxidant to stabilise the gel
benefits: Positions a dedicated hydration/glow booster distinct from volumising fillers
Ready-to-use format streamlines chairside workflow
Suits a broad patient base seeking skin-quality improvement
Fits combination and maintenance treatment protocols
Part of a recognised Korean HA product family
indications: Loss of elasticity and skin dullness
Face, neck and other thin-skin areas

description: Repadern (Repadern PN LHA+HHA) is a hybrid skinbooster that combines polynucleotide with dual-weight hyaluronic acid in a single syringe. The PN component targets regeneration and skin repair while high- and low-molecular-weight HA provide both structural support and deep hydration. It is designed for multi-point mesotherapy-style delivery across face and body.
howItWorks: The polynucleotide fraction (DNA-derived polymer) acts on tissue-regeneration and anti-inflammatory pathways, supporting fibroblast activity and collagen synthesis, while scavenging free radicals. The high-molecular-weight HA provides a supportive, longer-lasting hydrating matrix and the low-molecular-weight HA penetrates for immediate plumping. Together they combine biostimulation with hydration in one product.
composition: Per 2 mL syringe: high-molecular-weight HA 32 mg, low-molecular-weight HA 32 mg, polynucleotide (PN) 10 mg.
usageNotes: Delivered via the BAP (Bio Aesthetic Points) technique using roughly 5-9 injection points, with 27G-30G needles, into the dermis of forehead, glabella, periorbital, nasolabial and marionette areas, plus hands, inner arms and abdomen. Supplied as 2 mL x 3 syringes per box. Store cool and protected from light per manufacturer labelling.
features: PN + dual-weight HA in a single syringe
benefits: One product covers regeneration and hydration, reducing SKUs
Versatile across facial zones plus hands and body
Structured injection protocol supports consistent results
Appeals to patients wanting skin quality plus firmness
Multi-syringe box suits full-course treatment plans
indications: Hands, inner arms and abdomen skin quality

description: Misfill+ Baby Face is a growth-factor based skin-regeneration solution rather than a conventional hyaluronic acid booster. Its principal active is EGF (epidermal growth factor), combined with brightening and hydrating actives, intended for delivery through MTS microneedling, meso-injection or topical application. It is marketed for skin repair, texture refinement and radiance.
howItWorks: EGF binds the epidermal growth factor receptor to stimulate keratinocyte and fibroblast proliferation, supporting cell renewal and repair of damaged skin. Brightening actives such as niacinamide (and glutathione) help limit melanin transfer for a more even tone, while panthenol and hexanediol support hydration and barrier condition. The formulation is designed for penetration when micro-channelled or injected superficially.
composition: EGF (epidermal growth factor) as lead active, with niacinamide, glutathione, panthenol and 1,2-hexanediol among the supporting brightening/hydrating ingredients. Typically supplied in vials (commonly 5 mL).
usageNotes: Applied via MTS/microneedling, meso-gun, dermaroller or superficial meso-injection, and can also be used topically after energy-device or micro-channel treatments. To be administered by a trained practitioner. Store cool and protected from light per label; observe the labelled shelf life.
features: Flexible delivery: MTS, meso-gun, roller or topical
benefits: Complements HA and PN protocols with a regeneration/brightening step
Multiple delivery routes fit existing device workflows
Addresses tone, texture and post-procedure recovery
Suitable as an add-on to microneedling and laser services
Broad patient appeal for glow and skin-quality demand
indications: Dull, uneven or pigmented skin tone

description: AIOR 50 is a non-crosslinked, high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid skinbooster positioned as a bio-remodelling style hydrator. It contains 50 mg of HA per 2 mL with no BDDE or chemical cross-linking agents, so it works on skin quality rather than volume. Distributed internationally for professional face and body rejuvenation.
howItWorks: As a high-molecular-weight HA booster, it hydrates the dermis and remodels the extracellular matrix, helping to switch on fibroblast collagen and elastin production over a treatment course. The absence of cross-linking gives a spreadable gel that diffuses through tissue rather than holding a fixed shape. The result is improved density, elasticity and tone.
composition: Non-crosslinked high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid 50 mg / 2 mL; BDDE-free (no chemical cross-linker).
usageNotes: Injected superficially (approx. 1 mm) using a fine needle (e.g. 30G), commonly with a small number of bolus/aliquot points per treatment area on face or body. A typical course is around 3 sessions spaced 2-3 months apart. Supplied as a 2 mL prefilled syringe; store cool and protected from light and freezing per label.
benefits: Offers a bio-remodelling option within a Korean price point
Simple few-point protocol reduces chair time
Cross-linker-free profile supports patient reassurance
Versatile across facial and body zones
Fits maintenance and combination treatment plans
indications: Face, neck, decolletage and body areas

description: HP Vitaran i is a polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster from the HP Cell Vitaran range, presented in fine prefilled syringes for delicate and periocular skin. Its purified salmon/salmon-trout derived PN targets regeneration, hydration and skin resilience in thin, fragile areas. Designed for superficial intradermal micro-injection with very fine needles.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide is a DNA-derived polymer that activates tissue regeneration and exerts an anti-inflammatory effect, in part through selective binding to the adenosine A2A receptor, while supplying nucleotide building blocks and scavenging free radicals. This supports fibroblast activity, dermal repair and improved skin quality. The result is progressive strengthening and hydration of thin skin rather than volumising.
composition: Purified polynucleotide (PN) 2% (20 mg/mL) derived from salmon/salmon-trout DNA. Presented as prefilled syringes (e.g. 1 mL x 2), fine-gauge needles for periocular use.
usageNotes: Injected into the superficial dermis using fine needles (around 32G-34G for periocular skin), typically over a course of sessions 2-3 weeks apart with periodic maintenance. Store at 2-25C, protected from light and freezing per label. Prefilled and ready to use.
features: Regeneration plus hydration in one product
benefits: Dedicated PN option for the challenging eye area
Supports premium regenerative treatment menus
Ready-to-use format simplifies workflow
Complements HA boosters and energy devices
Backed by a recognised Korean PN brand family
indications: Periocular fine lines and crow's feet
Thin, fragile or crepey eyelid skin
Dark circles with a skin-quality component

description: HP Vitaran is a salmon-DNA derived polynucleotide/PDRN skinbooster from the HP Cell Vitaran line, formulated for skin healing and rejuvenation. It pairs regenerative nucleotides with a small amount of hyaluronic acid and is designed for flexible delivery by injection, meso-gun or micro-channel devices. Marketed for skin repair, firmness and photoageing across face, neck and hands.
howItWorks: The polynucleotide/PDRN fraction, based on salmon DNA nucleotides, drives tissue regeneration and anti-inflammatory activity and provides raw material for fibroblast repair, supporting collagen and improved skin resilience. The added hyaluronic acid contributes hydration and a more comfortable, spreadable base. The combined effect is regeneration plus moisture rather than volumising.
composition: Salmon-DNA derived PDRN/polynucleotide 0.5% with hyaluronic acid 0.2% (per the referenced meso/MTS presentation); typically supplied as 2 mL x 2 vials.
usageNotes: Applied via meso-injection, meso-gun, RF/fractional microneedling, dermaroller, or mixed with serums for micro-channel delivery to face, neck, hands and under-eye areas. Administer by a trained practitioner. Store at 1-30C, protected from sunlight; shelf life around 36 months per label.
benefits: Adaptable to multiple device-based service lines
Combines regenerative and hydrating claims in one SKU
Suits face, neck and hand rejuvenation menus
Vial format flexible for cocktail/mixing protocols
Part of an established Korean PN brand family
indications: Face, neck, hands and under-eye rejuvenation

description: Hanheal NAD+ Complex is an anti-ageing mesotherapy solution built around NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) for cellular-energy driven skin rejuvenation. It is supplied as a lyophilised NAD+ ampoule reconstituted with a solvent that also carries NMN, hyaluronic acid, peptides and collagen. Positioned for practitioners offering longevity-style skin treatments.
howItWorks: NAD+ is a coenzyme central to mitochondrial energy production and to sirtuin and PARP enzyme activity involved in DNA repair and stress response, so supplementing it aims to support cellular metabolism and repair. NMN acts as an NAD+ precursor, while hyaluronic acid, peptides and collagen add hydration and matrix support. The intended effect is cellular revitalisation alongside improved hydration and firmness.
composition: Lyophilised NAD+ (120 mg dry ampoule) reconstituted with a 5 mL solvent ampoule; formulation also cited as containing NMN, hyaluronic acid, peptides and collagen.
usageNotes: Reconstitute the dry ampoule with the solvent and mix gently until dissolved before use. Delivered by mesotherapy micro-injection into the mid dermis (approx. 0.5-2 mm) across face, neck or hands, with sessions typically spaced 1-2 weeks apart and periodic maintenance. Store cool and dark per label; use promptly after reconstitution.
features: NMN precursor plus HA, peptides and collagen
benefits: Differentiates the menu with an NAD+ longevity offering
Multi-active cocktail targets energy, hydration and firmness
Fresh reconstitution supports active integrity
Suits face, neck and hand mesotherapy protocols
Aligns with growing patient interest in cellular anti-ageing
indications: Tired, dull or stressed ageing skin
Fine lines and loss of firmness

description: VS Nad+ is presented as a NAD+ based mesotherapy skinbooster in the same active class as other Korean NAD+ complexes, using cellular-energy science for skin rejuvenation. A specific manufacturer and detailed formulation could not be independently verified from available sources, so composition specifics are given at the active-class level only. Intended for professional in-clinic micro-injection.
howItWorks: As an NAD+ mesotherapy product, the mechanism centres on NAD+, a coenzyme that fuels mitochondrial energy metabolism and supports sirtuin/PARP-linked DNA repair and stress-response pathways, aiming to revitalise skin cells. NAD+ precursors such as NMN, where present, are used to raise intracellular NAD+ availability. The intended outcome is improved cellular vitality, hydration and skin quality.
composition: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) as the core active; additional auxiliary ingredients not independently verified.
usageNotes: Intended for professional mesotherapy micro-injection into the mid dermis, or device-assisted delivery, over a course of sessions with periodic maintenance. If supplied as a dry + solvent system, reconstitute before use. Follow the specific manufacturer's storage and handling instructions (typically cool, dark storage).
benefits: Adds an NAD+ option to the rejuvenation menu
Targets cellular vitality alongside skin quality
Fits mesotherapy and cocktail workflows
Appeals to longevity-focused patient demand
Complements HA and PN based protocols

description: Richesse Collafilo is an absorbable atelocollagen based skinbooster/injectable from the Richesse range, using high-purity collagen to support skin structure and regeneration. The collagen is processed to remove antigenic telopeptides, lowering immune reactivity, and provides a biocompatible scaffold that helps firm and improve skin. It is used for skin revitalisation and contour/wrinkle support.
howItWorks: Injected atelocollagen supplies a biocompatible, biodegradable collagen matrix that acts as a scaffold for fibroblast attachment and supports tissue regeneration and dermal firmness. Removal of the telopeptide region reduces the antigenic portion of the collagen, lowering the risk of immune reaction. Over time the material is absorbed while contributing to improved skin structure and elasticity.
composition: 3% high-purity atelocollagen (telopeptide-removed collagen). Supplied as 1.0 mL syringes (e.g. x2) with 30G needles.
usageNotes: Delivered by intradermal injection for skin revitalisation and for wrinkle/contour support; administer with fine needles per technique. Supplied as prefilled syringes with needles included. Store refrigerated (around 2-8C) per label; shelf life around 24 months.
benefits: Adds a collagen-stimulating modality to the menu
Low-antigenicity profile supports patient reassurance
Dual use for skin quality and contour/wrinkle support
Ready-to-use prefilled presentation
Part of a recognised Korean regenerative brand family
indications: Loss of skin firmness and elasticity
